context:
Goal: a session notices when a reply to its message never comes.
Problem (rule): two of your rules conflict. outcomes-mechanize-rules bars tracking on a timer; git-ci-wait-checks-in allows a timed check-in while waiting on CI.
Based on (notes): review round 1 of lane session-messaging-plan, 2026-11-06.
Departs from: main — adds one timed check-in per cloud message that waits on a reply.
Meanwhile: the lane fixes its skill text and hands its branch to the batch runner; the record marks this open.

lastAnswer.note: are these really the two options i should consider?

options.how: One one-time check-in per waiting message. It starts no program and writes no file.
options.label: Allow one check-in per wait

options.how: The session checks only when it next starts a turn.
options.label: No timer
options.lose: A lost message can stall until something else wakes the session.

reply: Moved off the page (your 316 note): roadmap step ask-again-msg-wait-checkin, phase later, asks again with better options once the session mailbox (#1371) lands.
title: When a session waits on a reply to its message, may it set one timed check-in?
why: Recommended a: a lost message gets caught, and the check-in starts no program and writes no file.
